# C2 development checkpoint before MS1 integration

Branch: feat/edit-loop-windows. Worktree: C:/src/quantick-worktrees/ci-edit-loop-windows.
HEAD/base: 432632239f924883c07e76904551be0faf0f37eb.
Staged source tree: f6bacdd4beeff700006e1873a175beea34752277.
No code commit, full ordered workspace loop, actual benchmark, calibrated
budget, draft PR, independent final review or score is claimed here.

## Observed development failures, preserved rather than relabelled

- Initial fixture-first execution failed to import not-yet-implemented budgets.
- The temporary fixture checkout initially used CRLF while its Git blob was
  LF. The fixture now explicitly writes LF and sets local core.autocrlf=false;
  the source-byte assertion was retained.
- Windows Python rejected os.utime(..., follow_symlinks=False). Original raw
  output is tests-initial-implementation.log. The implementation now uses a
  retained regular-file metadata handle; unchanged restoration assertions
  passed in tests-metadata-handle.log.
- New evidence fixtures initially cleared PATH along with the environment;
  four cases failed with FileNotFoundError from launching Git. Only the fake
  Cargo environment seam is now injected; real fixture Git retains PATH.
- Ruff found one unused pathlib.Path import during intermediate implementation;
  the import was removed then reintroduced when later fixtures actually used it.
- Intermediate staged diff hygiene reported one blank line at EOF in
  process_owner.py. That line was removed and current hygiene passed.

The last three entries retain exact diagnostic summaries from tool outputs,
not a claim that their complete raw transcripts were archived. This is
pre-review development; operation failures remain 1 from the rejected branch
prefix, and published-review repair batches remain 0.

## Root pre-freeze feedback and bounded response

1. A root PID exiting did not prove its descendants stopped, including the
   taskkill/parent-exit race and after-sample unknown compilers. Windows now
   assigns a waiting helper to a kill-on-close job before starting Cargo and
   requires zero active job processes. A real newly-owned parent/child fixture
   confirms a child cannot survive the parent's exit unnoticed. Linux uses a
   retained subreaper/session leader, but active-descendant or escape uncertainty
   refuses restoration even after best-effort group cleanup. No unrelated
   process is killed. The after-sample unknown-owner fixture also refuses
   restoration. Linux execution itself still needs CI evidence.
2. A sorted, internally consistent ranking and an incomplete hash map could
   previously pass raw-evidence validation. The checker now materializes only
   validated exact Git blobs in a new temporary directory, executes none of
   them, reruns the frozen lexer, and requires the complete expected hash map,
   profile hash and executable measurement-protocol hash. Wrong top-three,
   empty/missing input, archive escape/export omission and non-commit SHA
   fixtures reject those cases. No frozen source was changed.

## Current bounded checks

- Edit-loop offline fixtures: 29 PASS, 18.483 seconds; complete stdout/stderr
  text in offline-tests-29-f6bacdd4.log. Real subprocess fixtures only run Python,
  never Cargo or the Quantick application.
- Read-cost fixtures: 9 PASS, 8.205 seconds.
- Frozen outside-measure lexer fixtures: 17 PASS, 0.357 seconds.
- ruff check --select F tools/ bridge/mt5/: PASS.
- Existing own guard binary --file for every staged path: PASS.
- git diff --cached --check: PASS.
- YAML structural parse: ci/read-cost/windows jobs retained; one edit-loop job.
- All seven frozen Git blob IDs in the index equal initial eb7bb039434667bb150be9cdf5237e172c4198fe.

No test above is a Cargo timing sample or an outside/quantick score. The
remaining sequence is fresh MS1 campaign-base adoption, full ordered local
validation under a root-leased target, source freeze/commit/publication under
root's exact-SHA journal, hosted Windows calibration with raw artifacts,
reviewed fixed budgets, and current independent reviews/CI.

## Receipt-proof follow-up

After the preceding checkpoint, root identified that missing/null ownership
receipt fields could be accepted as if they proved quiescence. Sampling and
budget validation now require literal tree_quiescent=true and
orphaned_descendants=false; timeout and interruption still fail. Legitimate
offline receipts now supply those fields. A manifest-refreshed regression
checks missing/null/false quiescence and missing/null/true orphan receipts.
No original assertion was weakened.

Corrected staged source tree: 5260eefd0b0f90f144dab1ac4694e5cad825973e.
Windows offline suite: 30 PASS, 19.939 seconds, complete concatenated output
from session 75367 in offline-tests-30-5260eefd.log. Ruff F lint over all tools/
and bridge/mt5/ and staged diff hygiene also PASS. The prior 29-test log
remains evidence only for its original f6bacdd4 input. No Linux execution,
full Cargo loop, code commit or calibration is inferred from this follow-up.
